script.source: The 61 template names ApplyAuraEffect for initial and scheduled reapplication of child 701 and ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation for 3 IS every five seconds.
script.runtime: AbilityAuras runs the initial child pulse and schedules repeat work per caster. It debits IS before the next pulse and ends on shortfall, toggled shutdown or source scope loss.
script.test: StarterPathogenistAuraSightMode proves initial and scheduled child 701 plus shutdown. PathogenistAuraDeactivatesBeforeAnUnaffordablePulse checks exact 3 IS upkeep, refusal of an unaffordable pulse and no charge after shutdown. The native comment confirms the toggle and sight exclusion. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/588#issuecomment-7054857954

behavior-tests.source: GOB 61 records 5 IS activation and 28 s own reuse. The enabled parent reapplies 701 around the caster and has a five-second 3 IS drain.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHandler admits the loaded self-toggle. AbilityAuras uses the child's six-metre hostile radius, tracks the caster's own activation and terminates before an unaffordable pulse. The child applies two −14 defense modifiers for five seconds.
behavior-tests.test: AurasReadTheirDrainAndEffectFromTheTemplate and PathogenistAuraDeactivatesBeforeAnUnaffordablePulse cover the configured cost callback and shutdown. StarterHackerAuraRadiusMode covers the exact radius, StarterHackerHostileAurasMode covers overlapping casters, and StarterPathogenistAuraSightMode and the native comment cover pulse and sight. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/588#issuecomment-7054857954
